description: Java class representing a '<server>' element configuration, parsing XML attributes related to server properties for the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Models the '<server>' XML element including configuration attributes for server setup in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: Server
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server object by parsing attributes from an XML Element.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the server.

methods.name: getJndiName
methods.description: Returns the JNDI name for the server.

methods.name: getListen
methods.description: Returns whether the server is configured to listen for connections.

methods.name: getListenerClass
methods.description: Returns the listener class used by the server.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username associated with the server.
